description_en: Updates the agent information in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the instance ID and agent account name. You can update the display name and skill groups of the agent
description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称修改悉犀客服工作台坐席信息。支持修改坐席对外显示名称、坐席所属技能组
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs update-agent --instance-id 'ccc_xp_pre-cn-***' --account-name username@example.com --display-name 'XX测试' --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAgent

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate the value
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一ID。用于幂等校验，可以用UUID生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance. You can obtain the instance ID from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The account name of the agent, which is the mobile phone number or email address specified during account registration. The account name must be unique within the instance.
This parameter cannot be updated
parameters.help_zh:
坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一。
不支持更新
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The display name of the agent
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The skill group to which the agent belongs
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of skill groups to which the agent belongs
parameters.name: skill_group_id_list

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of Success indicates that the call is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示调用成功

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: successful.
false: failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
